verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents its own metadata filtering through `where(...)` conditions, applied as a pre-filter before vector search, and a community member notes predicate pushdown for filters. The evidence does not show which operators those conditions support. Missing for 10: documented range operators, geo/spatial filters, nested boolean (AND/OR/NOT grouping) examples, array-membership operators, and independent hands-on corroboration of complex filters.

support.subject: As a developer, I can express rich filter conditions (ranges, geo, nested boolean logic, array membership) in queries

citations.quote: LanceDB supports filtering features of query results based on metadata fields.
Pre-filtering means LanceDB applies the metadata `where(...)` condition before running vector search, so the search only considers rows that already match the filter.
They do predicate pushdown for filtering too.
